verdict.rationale: Claude Code's own overview documents a first-party skills feature: developers can create skills that package repeatable workflows, such as /review-pr or /deploy-staging, and share them with their team. The evidence is a single overview sentence, so how skills are defined, scoped, and applied to specialized tasks is unproven. MCP custom tooling and CLAUDE.md are adjacent features and are not credited here. Missing for 10: detailed skill-authoring documentation (file format, structure, bundled scripts or resources), evidence of how skills are invoked or auto-selected for specialized tasks, and independent or hands-on corroboration that custom skills work as described.

support.subject: As a developer, I can equip the agent with custom skills to perform specialized tasks

citations.quote: Create skills to package repeatable workflows your team can share, like `/review-pr` or `/deploy-staging`.
